US [continual]: Harvested weed datasets usually box only the species they were built for, so other weeds in the same image are unlabelled background. This is the same missing-annotations problem, and it grows with each increment. Pseudo-labelling those images with the accepted model (or the OWLv2/BioCLIP labeller agent) before merging directly counters the damage that 'added data is not free' (tier ladder 0.5601 [note truncated at collection]
